description: Free, open-source C++20 library for working with PDF documents: open, edit and save PDFs, extract text, render pages to PNG/JPEG/BMP/TIFF, create documents with text, tables, vector graphics, annotations and AcroForm fields, encrypt/decrypt (RC4, AES-128/256) and sign (detached PKCS#7). No third-party runtime dependencies. Native static library for Visual Studio C++ projects: x64, x86 and ARM64, Release and Debug.
summary: Free, open-source, dependency-free C++20 PDF library (native static library for Visual Studio).
title: Aspose.PDF FOSS for C++
